gen.title: pH acidity ladder
gen.quote: pH is reported in "logarithmic units". Each number represents a 10-fold change in the acidity/basicness of the water.

rungs.label: Neutral water at pH 7
rungs.quote: The range goes from 0 to 14, with 7 being neutral.

rungs.label: Water example at pH 6
rungs.quote: water having a pH of six.

rungs.label: Water example at pH 5
rungs.quote: Water with a pH of five is ten times more acidic

rungs.label: Normal rainfall at pH 5.6
rungs.quote: Normal rainfall has a pH of about 5.6—slightly acidic due to carbon dioxide gas from the atmosphere.

rungs.label: Mine drainage at pH 2
rungs.quote: water coming out of an abandoned coal mine can have a pH of 2

checks.message: every log-ladder title, page-word field, rung/case count, id and label shape is within the frozen limits
all 6 quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quotes-verbatim)
the quote states the factor in the page's own words: "10-fold" occurs in the quote and means 10 per whole step (factor-stated)
the quote names the scale "pH" as a whole phrase and the direction of the effect "more acidic" (increasing false) is bound to a known scale or stated by the quote (quantity-in-quote)

rungs[1] (rung-6-example): the value 6 does not occur as a whole number in its quote "water having a pH of six." (a number inside a larger number, like 3 inside 33 or 6 inside 6.3, is a different value) (rung-values-in-quote); rungs[2] (rung-5-example): the value 5 does not occur as a whole number in its quote "Water with a pH of five is ten times more acidic" (a number inside a larger number, like 3 inside 33 or 6 inside 6.3, is a different value) (rung-values-in-quote)
all 5 rung values are distinct points on the scale (rungs-distinct)

all 1 case(s) move between distinct values that ARE rungs of this ladder (inside the rung range 2 to 7), and every ratio our engine computes (6 → 5.6 is 2.51189 times) stays within 1000000000000 (cases-valid)

rungs[1].label states the number 6, which does not appear as that whole number on the page or in the same quote (N-01); rungs[2].label states the number 5, which does not appear as that whole number on the page or in the same quote (N-01)
log-ladder-v1: no weakening — every one of the 0 changed field(s) sits under the affected paths recomputed from revision 1, item counts and ids are stable, and no tolerance increased
